subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should `current` and `session:*` cron jobs permanently store `delivery.mode="announce"` during creation, or continue deriving fallback delivery from their persistent runtime session route?
rationale: The change alters persisted delivery semantics for a newly restored product mode, while the existing persistent-session contract does not establish that these targets should adopt isolated-style stored defaults.

options.title: Keep Runtime-Derived Delivery
options.body: Retain isolated-only initial persistence and repair the persistent runtime route only if an exact-head delivery failure is demonstrated.

options.title: Persist Announce Defaults
options.body: Accept the new stored behavior only with explicit upgrade semantics, aligned documentation, and real before-and-after delivery proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime-Derived Delivery
recommendation.body: Retain isolated-only initial persistence and repair the persistent runtime route only if an exact-head delivery failure is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The persistent-session product contract was established by the restoration work they authored and merged.
